incident.symptom: The LaunchAgent found the exact Homebrew gcloud executable, but the Cloud SDK process still failed immediately under launchd and emitted the Google Cloud CLI install documentation URL.

diagnosis.summary: The Homebrew Cloud SDK launcher requires a supported Python runtime discoverable in its process environment. The LaunchAgent environment did not include the Homebrew Python directory.
diagnosis.official_reference: Google Cloud CLI startup/install documentation requires supported Python on macOS; Homebrew installs should use their installation environment rather than forcing CLOUDSDK_PYTHON.
